verdict.rationale: Temporal's core value proposition is exactly this: durable execution guarantees that workflows resume from the last completed step after crashes/deploys/infrastructure failure, with automatic activity retries and event-history-based state reconstruction (temporal-docs-1, temporal-docs-4, temporal-docs-18, temporal-docs-25). Community evidence corroborates real-world use for long-running, cross-machine reliable execution (temporal-comm-7, temporal-comm-8, temporal-comm-9), though one report notes rough edges in error/anomaly handling and documentation quality (temporal-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent benchmark or incident-report confirming exact-resume behavior under a real production crash/deploy scenario beyond vendor docs and anecdotal community praise.
